title: Careers — Content

fields.message: Careers — one tab per section. Edits fill that section's {{slots}} on the live page. Shortcode attributes still override, and a blank field falls back to the built-in default.

fields.label: Show this section
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_show_section
fields.instructions: Untick to take this section off the live page. Nothing is deleted — the wording below stays exactly as it is and comes straight back when you tick it again. Takes up to two minutes to show on the site.

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_heading
fields.instructions: The hero display headline. Approved editable by Sean 2026-08-13. LENGTH IS A HINT, NOT A LIMIT — under ~50 characters keeps it to 3 lines at 1440, but character count is only a proxy because WORD length drives the break: careers-hero renders 4 lines at 42 characters where community-hero renders 3 at 43, same rule and same width. 4 lines is the practical ceiling; at ~70 characters the headline is 5 lines and consumes the whole fold, pushing the next section off-screen. Measured, not guessed. The hero doodles were pinned to the padding band first (b324b35) so a longer headline can no longer drag one into the type — before that fix the top mark fell 43px between a 3-line and a 5-line headline and ended up level with the first line. NOTE this headline STARTS a line closer to the ceiling than the other three — it is already 4 lines at its current 42 characters, so it has roughly one line of headroom rather than two. PRESS RETURN to force a line break exactly where you want one.
fields.default_value: Come work somewhere you actually want to be

fields.label: Sub copy — before the highlight
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_sub_1
fields.instructions: Everything up to and including the em dash. The space before the highlight is in the markup, so no trailing space here.
fields.default_value: We're building careers here, not just filling shifts. If you're driven, hospitality-minded, and ready to grow —

fields.label: Sub copy — highlighted phrase
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_sub_highlight
fields.instructions: Sits in the yellow marker block that closes the sentence. Short — it is a highlight, not a clause.

fields.label: Highlight animation
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_hl_variant
fields.instructions: How the marker highlight behind the sub copy arrives. h3 (default) rough hand-drawn block + ~5deg angled wipe, closest to the comps. h1 background wipe — THE ONLY ONE THAT SURVIVES A LINE WRAP; switch to it if you lengthen 'Sub highlight' enough to reflow, because h3's block is one rigid shape that cannot wrap with the text. h0 static, no animation. Unknown or blank renders a static painted mark, never blank. Catalog: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Underline animation
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_uline_variant
fields.instructions: How the hand-drawn underline (line-careers-lg.svg) reveals. u3 (default) filled brush + ~5deg angled wipe, keeps the taper. wipe straight-edged reveal, the conservative fallback. u1 scaleX bar — this is what this hero used BEFORE the artwork swap, kept so the old look can be compared live. Unknown or blank renders the mark static and visible, never hidden. Catalog: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Background photo
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_bg_photo
fields.instructions: Optional. Leave this empty and the hero keeps the flat dark color it has today — nothing changes until you choose a photo. The photo fills the whole hero and is cropped to fit, so its exact size does not matter; around 1920px on the long edge is plenty and anything bigger only slows the page. Light photos make white headlines hard to read, which is what the two overlay settings below are for. If you also set a background video below, this photo is what shows while the video loads and for anyone who has animation switched off.

fields.label: Background photo — phones
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_bg_photo_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A version of the hero photo for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave empty and the main photo above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main photo is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or tighter version reads far better.

fields.label: Background photo — color
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_bg_photo_tone
fields.instructions: Color is the default. Switch this photo to black and white when you want it that way on purpose — the photography on this site was only ever gray because the placeholder images were. Affects this photo alone.

fields.label: Background photo — movement
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_bg_photo_px
fields.instructions: How far this photo drifts inside its frame as you scroll, as a percentage of the frame's height. 0 is off. The dropdown this replaces offered 6, 10 and 16 as Subtle, Medium and Strong, so anything already set still reads exactly the same — you can now pick the values in between. 40 is the ceiling: the page itself stops there, so a larger number would do nothing. The photo is laid out taller than its frame and slides within it, so an edge never appears and it is never zoomed.

fields.label: Background photo — movement direction
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_bg_photo_px_dir
fields.instructions: Which way this photo travels as the page scrolls. Neighboring photos set in opposite directions are what reads as depth.

fields.label: Overlay color
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_overlay_color
fields.instructions: A flat color laid over the background photo to keep the headline readable. This does nothing when no photo is set. Choose None to turn the overlay off entirely.

fields.label: Overlay strength
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_overlay_strength
fields.instructions: How much of the overlay color shows through. Only has an effect once an overlay color is chosen above. 45% is the usual setting for white type over a photo — go higher if the headline still fights the picture, lower if the photo is already dark.

fields.label: Background video (optional)
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_video_id
fields.instructions: Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link, or just the ID. Leave blank to use the photo above, or the flat hero color if there is no photo. The video plays silently on a loop with no controls. The photo shows while the video loads, if the video is blocked, and for visitors who have switched off animation — so it is worth setting one as well.

fields.label: Video from
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_video_source
fields.instructions: Which service the link is from. Only matters when a video is set.

fields.label: Section background
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_section_bg
fields.instructions: A pattern or photo filling this whole section, behind everything else. Leave it empty — as it is now — and the section keeps the plain color it has today; nothing changes until you choose something. It is cropped to fill, so the exact size does not matter. ON A DARK SECTION USE A LIGHT OR GRAY ARTWORK: a black pattern over a black panel stays invisible however high you set the strength below. ON A HERO THIS SITS BEHIND THE HERO PHOTO, so it only shows where that photo does not: with a background photo set, the photo covers the section edge to edge and this is hidden entirely. Use it on a hero with no photo, where it replaces the flat color.

fields.label: Background strength
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_section_bg_opacity
fields.instructions: How strongly the background shows through. Choose 100% when the artwork already has the intended strength built into the file — anything lower then fades a graphic that was supplied ready to use. Use the lower values when a full-strength image would compete with the words in front of it.

fields.label: Background movement
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_section_bg_px
fields.instructions: Drifts the background as the page scrolls, behind the content, as a percentage of the section's height. 0 is off — the right starting point, because a pattern moving too fast pulls the eye away from the copy. 6 is subtle, 10 medium, 16 strong, and anything in between is allowed. 40 is the ceiling; the page stops there.

fields.label: Background movement direction
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_section_bg_px_dir
fields.instructions: Which way the background travels as the page scrolls. Only matters once movement above is above 0. Neighboring sections set in opposite directions are what reads as depth rather than as one sheet sliding.

fields.label: Section background — phones
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_section_bg_mobile
fields.instructions: Optional. A version of the background for phones, used below 768px wide. Leave it empty and the main background above is used at every size. Worth setting when the main artwork is wide: cropped to a narrow screen it often shows nothing recognizable, and a tall or simplified version reads far better.

fields.label: Show the divider icon
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_show_divider
fields.instructions: The round badge that sits between this section and the one above it. Untick to remove just the badge — the section itself stays.

fields.label: Body copy — first paragraph
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_body_1
fields.instructions: Left column, opening paragraph. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write an em dash as a literal —, not —.
fields.default_value: This isn't your average restaurant gig. At BRG, we invest in our people — with real training, real growth paths, and a culture that actually lives up to the hype.

fields.label: Body copy — second paragraph
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_body_2
fields.instructions: Left column, second paragraph. The two paragraphs are separate fields because the two-paragraph break is layout, not content.
fields.default_value: Whether you're starting your first job in hospitality or you're a seasoned operator looking for your next move, there's a place for you here. We promote from within, develop leaders intentionally, and build teams that stick around.

fields.label: Right column heading
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_offers_heading
fields.instructions: Sits above the asterisk-bulleted list. Short — it renders in the display face at up to 2.2rem, so ~14 characters keeps it on one line. The list items themselves are not editable; they are code.

fields.label: Button label
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_cta_label
fields.instructions: Black-bordered button at the foot of the section. ~18 characters.

fields.label: Button link
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_cta_href
fields.instructions: Defaults to the in-page anchor for the open-positions section below. A full URL works too.

fields.label: Highlight animation
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_hl_variant
fields.instructions: How the marker highlight behind “to work here” arrives. h3 (default) rough hand-drawn block + ~5deg angled wipe, closest to the comps. h1 background wipe — THE ONLY ONE THAT SURVIVES A LINE WRAP. h0 static, no animation, which is what this mark did before. fields.label: Heading
fields.name: brg_careers_positions_heading
fields.instructions: Display face on the yellow band, up to ~3.5rem. Wraps freely. ~30 characters keeps it to two lines.

fields.label: Sub copy
fields.name: brg_careers_positions_sub
fields.instructions: One line beneath the heading. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write & and — as literal characters.
fields.default_value: Browse our open roles below — from front-of-house to leadership positions across Board & Brew and Odie's Pizza Co.

fields.label: Button label
fields.name: brg_careers_positions_cta_label

fields.label: Button link
fields.name: brg_careers_positions_cta_href
fields.instructions: Defaults to the in-page anchor for the roles list.

fields.label: Photo
fields.name: brg_careers_positions_photo
fields.instructions: The cut-out figure beside the open positions. A PNG with a transparent background keeps the cut-out effect; a normal photo will show its rectangle. Around 578x709. Leave empty to keep the current picture.
